notes:
Account background: mid-market ITSM vendor (CatalystDesk Labs) — strong PLG motion for SMBs but now selling to mid-market enterprises. Interested in embedded chat for internal IT helpdesk (desktop tooling) + an external admin-facing support assistant. Primary ask: very low latency for streaming replies and tool calling for ticket lookups.

Key quoted requirements: "Realtime feels like sub-200ms for short replies; streaming important. Tool calls must be stable with clear fallbacks." — VP Product.

Security: SSO/SAML is mandatory; audit logs and retention controls required for 2 years for compliance team. Prefer customer-managed KMS and ability to pin model versions. Data residency: US & EU.

Technical: Expected concurrency ~150-300 concurrent agents during business hours, spikes to ~600 during incidents. Latency SLO target: p50 < 120ms for short-turn chat frames, p95 < 350ms; tail latency visibility required in console. Workload: chat + tool calling (ticket search, user lookup), streaming tokens to UI, embedding-based reranking for KB search.

POC specifics: Redwood hosted API demo done 2026-02-11 (basic chat + tool calling). Redwood to run a 2-week POC on hosted API using CatalystDesk sample traffic (anonymized). POC success metrics: 95% of responses under p95 target, <1.5% error/fallback rate, streaming stability, correctness of tool call bindings. If POC meets targets, follow-up to evaluate Dedicated reserved pool for predictable throughput and audit isolation.

Commercial: Price sensitivity around per-token costs during heavy incident windows. Prefer committed monthly capacity if Redwood can guarantee tail latency and audit controls; finance requested a model for burst costs and overage.
